package.name: calib_sample_guard
package.description: Live guardrail for hand-eye calibration sampling: watches /detections for the calibration tag and continuously reports reprojection error and tilt angle from head-on, warning before a bad sample (noisy detection, or a near-head-on view at risk of the planar-PnP pose-ambiguity problem) gets taken -- meant to run alongside easy_handeye2's rqt_calibrator during a live session, not as an after-the-fact audit (saved samples don't retain the raw pixel corners needed to recompute this).
